_about: London (level_09) without anomalies, its spawns where the owner placed them in the map editor (the owner, 2026-10-25: "let's remove anomalies from London, move spawns closer to bases like in newer Londons"; then, in the map editor: "I expect them to be closer to the exit of the building"). Every London project: day_2 (batteries, mode 2), day_3 (batteries with chargers, mode 3), day_4 (Team Deathmatch) and day_5 (Research, pack research-mode@3). Removed (remove_entry, by full_name and type): the 7 anomalies of patch 14 (terrain/random_anomaly*: 3 lifebone, 2 spring, 2 onyx), each its generic_anomaly_core, artefact_container, damage_zone (its idle particle and sound are the zone's own) and the two collision_geometry of its zone and artefact, 35 entries a project; in day_2 and day_3 the two inv_zone effect zones and their inv_collision boxes around the old outdoor spawns (no point spawns there now; the points' original invulnerability_time stays: 6 s in batteries, chargers and Research; 3 s in Team Deathmatch). Moved (set_entry, from the map editor's list map-edits/level_09.json, re-based on the live points): server_objects/respawn_points, 10 a team, the same count, order and names, the same places in all four projects. team1 (west): building_06_1's first floor (y 9.25), placed to match team2's, 13-26.5 m walk from the door whose stairs go down to the street (about (-47, 7.8, 7.0)), 44-65 m walk from its battery container. team2 (east): building_10's first floor (y 9.52-9.56), the owner's 8 points and 2 beside them (respawn_point and respawn_point(1)), 68-74 m walk from its container. A point the owner moved without turning keeps the facing it had in the editor. Changes the simulation (simulation_changes.tsv).
